schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme. PDF 13–15 Léamhthuiscint A (with the Paper 2 heading and note, and its mark boxes); 16–18 Léamhthuiscint B; 19–21 Prós Ainmnithe (2A); 22 Prós Roghnach (2B); 23–24 Filíocht Ainmnithe (3A); 25–26 Filíocht Roghnach (3B); 27 modified marking (SMM; 28 is its Paper 1 table). PDF 1–12 belong to Paper 1; 29–32 are blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (1–3 cover and instructions, 4–7 the two reading passages, 8–12 literature) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Reading: all ten questions are required; each printed (a)/(b) part is a 5-mark practice card beside the whole question. Two-point items (“3 mharc + 2 mharc”, or Reading B 1(b)’s “An chéad … = 3 mharc; an dara … = 2 mharc”) are order-dependent (first correct point 3, second 2) and stay whole at 0/3/5; single answers allow 0/5, or 0/3/5 where the scheme prints a 3-mark partial answer.
Reading language: “Gaeilge lochtach: 0 - 5 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh” is one deduction from each 50-mark passage total; cards state it without applying it inside a part.

Prescribed prose (2A): (a) Oisín i dTír na nÓg prints five sub-questions the scheme prices at 5 each: the whole question is a 25-mark card and every sub-question is also a practice card. (b) Dís is one 25-mark question (five points at 2 + 3).

Prescribed poetry (3A): each poem is a whole 25-mark card with its printed tariffs ((a) Mo ghrá-sa (idir lúibíní): (i) 8, (ii) 9, (iii) 8; (b) Géibheann: (i) 9, (ii) 8, (iii) 8) and one 0–4 Gaeilge deduction; every printed sub-question is also a practice card. 3A(a)(i) prints four questions (a)–(d) at 2 each: the sub-question keeps 0/2/4/6/8 and each question is its own practice card.
Optional prose (2B) and optional poetry (3B) stay whole: the text is open content chosen by the candidate. 3B(b) asks for a modern poem not used in 3B(a).
Choice is not a route: Ceist 2 and Ceist 3 are each A or B; each printed question is one card carrying the printed choice and “Freagair (a) agus (b) anseo.”; no combination cards.
Literature language: “Gaeilge lochtach: 0-4 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh” is one deduction from each 25-mark question, never inside one sub-question.
sourceFindings: Paper 2 = 200: Ceist 1 reading 100 (A Éire an Lae Inniu 50, B Caitríona Perry: Craoltóir, Láithreoir agus Údar 50; ten questions at (a) 5 + (b) 5 each), Ceist 2 prose 50 (A Prós Ainmnithe: (a) Oisín i dTír na nÓg 25 + (b) Dís 25; or B Prós Roghnach: (a) scéal béaloidis 25 + (b) gearrscéal 25), Ceist 3 poetry 50 (A Filíocht Ainmnithe: (a) Mo ghrá-sa (idir lúibíní) 25 + (b) Géibheann 25; or B Filíocht Roghnach: (a) 25 + (b) 25).

The scheme’s text layer stores nine boxed headings with the page body (“CEIST 1 (A + B) - LÉAMHTHUISCINT - 100 marc”, “A – (50 marc)”, “B – (50 marc)”, the CEIST 2/3 and section boxes); the builder removes those exact strings (count pinned).

Each reading passage prints one note above Ceist 1 (“Nóta: Má tá dhá phointe eolais i gceist, tá 3 mharc ar an gcéad cheann atá ceart agus 2 mharc ar an dara ceann atá ceart.”), carried with every part’s key; the penalty note (“Nóta: Gearrfar pionós i ngeall ar iomarcaíocht. Léireofar an pionós …”) and the mark boxes close each passage, and the last part’s key ends before them.

Reading B Ceist 1(b) prices its two points under a bare “5 mharc” (“An chéad phíosa eolais atá ceart = 3 mharc; an dara píosa eolais atá ceart = 2 mharc”), without “3 mharc + 2 mharc =”; it is a 0/3/5 part like the other two-point parts.

Each literature answer ends with “[Gaeilge lochtach: 0-4 …]” (eight, all alike); the deduction is its own criterion. Unlike 2020, the 2018 scheme prints no “Léirigh mionbhriseadh na marcanna” mark-panel line.

2018 2B(b) (gearrscéal roghnach) prices its account as one block, “5 phointe eolais ag teastáil (5 mharc an ceann ar an gcéad trí phointe eolais + 4 mharc an ceann ar an dá phointe eolais eile) (23 marc)”, with no separate theme mark (2020’s 2B(a) had one); title 1 + author 1.
3A(a)(i) Mo ghrá-sa prints four questions (a)–(d), each “(2 mharc) Freagraí Samplacha: …” with the verse it draws on (“Véarsa a haon, Línte 3 + 4 = 2 mharc”).
The scheme’s Dís quotation prints “Toradh surbhé a deineadh”; the paper prints “Toradh suirbhé a deineadh”. The card’s question is the paper’s print; the scheme slice is lifted as printed.
The paper prints “‐” (U+2010) in “nua‐aimseartha”, “1‐8”, “t‐ainmhí” and “Mo ghrá‐sa”; cards print the ASCII hyphen, as the scheme does.
No 2018 Ordinary card existed before this review; the 53 cards are new.
